name: LRU Cache with TTL and Thread Safety
task:
Please complete the following LRU cache with TTL task.

Design an LRU cache (capacity 3) with a hash map and a doubly-linked list, plus a per-entry expiry timestamp.

Implement get(key) and put(key, value, ttl) in O(1), evicting the least recently used entry when full.

Implement lazy expiration: a get on an expired key returns miss and removes it.

Guard operations with a lock. Simulate: put(1,a,ttl=100), put(2,b,ttl=5), put(3,c,ttl=100), get(1), put(4,d,ttl=100) [evicts 2], then after expiry, get(2). Report the cache contents and the result of get(2).

最终回答必须包含: get(1)结果=___, 淘汰的key=___, get(2)结果=___.
